# Third-party frontend assets

- Bootstrap 5.3.8 — MIT — https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap
- Alpine.js 3.14.9 — MIT — https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine
- HTMX 4.0.1 — Zero-Clause BSD — https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx
- Font Awesome Free 6.7.2 — icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT. The package's full license notice is included in fontawesome/LICENSE.txt.
- Google Fonts are referenced remotely. Demo product/store photographs come from Unsplash and are illustrative sample inventory. The sample photographs are cached locally in static/demo. Seller-supplied image URLs may remain remote.

The supplied DQTech logo is used unchanged. illustrations.svg contains original code-native SVG artwork created for this project.
